scope: Full accepted Windows residential/light-commercial measurement and architectural/3D plan; public GPL ownership

rubric.2: focused behavior evidence for implemented portions
rubric.3: meaningful installed workflow evidence for implemented portions
rubric.4: full acceptance including required external qualification

rows.requirement: Drawing, editing, calculating, saving, recovering, printing, and exporting work with networking disabled.
The application has no account, activation server, subscription, or online entitlement dependency.
Installation is offline-capable and bundles required runtime components, fonts, help, libraries, resources, and optional local-assistance assets.
Publish the original application source under GPL-3.0-or-later with reproducible Windows build instructions, fixtures, and build configuration.
Provide a documented, versioned .bldproj project format whose geometry, classifications, assets, metadata, history, and migrations are inspectable locally.
The production application targets Windows 11 x64, supports imperial and metric units, and serves residential and light-commercial projects.
Measurement and Architectural are separate workspaces over one shared project and authoritative document model.
One semantic document model is authoritative for property/site, buildings, storeys, levels, layers, objects, boundaries, annotations, schedules, sheets, phases, and alternatives.
Typed links distinguish architectural walls, room boundaries, and appraisal measurement boundaries, with explicit ownership and no unconstrained bidirectional cycles.
Save serializes an immutable snapshot at revision R into a validated standalone project while preserving the prior destination file.
Every authoritative output carries an OutputFingerprint for document revision, profiles, assets, fonts, views, and processing components.
All edits use typed serialized commands over immutable snapshots; accepted compound operations commit atomically and are reversible.
Entered quantities and units remain distinct from derived values, with analytical geometry, explicit tolerances, and display rounding that never changes measurement truth.
BRep geometry, meshes, projections, render pixels, and calculation caches are derived data and cannot become independent document authorities.
Migrations are copy-based and reversible, preserve originals and unknown data, and block unsafe editing or authoritative output for unsupported required features.
Provide a documented JSON-and-assets exchange representation plus local inspect, validate, extract, and migrate CLI operations.
Apex exchange, CAD exchange, devices, georeferencing, and appraisal integrations attach through replaceable versioned adapters.
Qualify exact source revisions, build options, transitive dependencies, and distribution obligations for every shipped component before release.
GPL-3.0-or-later first-party application code remains clearly separated from third-party code, with contribution and license provenance suitable for public distribution.
The baseline excludes GPL/AGPL application dependencies, noncommercial restrictions, and mandatory paid runtime SDKs; applicable LGPL components meet their obligations.
Use a qualified Open CASCADE Technology layer for solid geometry, tessellation, and visualization with the original application model above it.
Use PlaneGCS/Eigen behind an application-owned planar constraint adapter; Ceres is not the planar solver substitute.
Use isolated local workers for reviewed IFC and DXF parsing/export components, with adapter manifests and no dependency on a hosted service.
Use reviewed Qt PDF and Print Support modules for vector output and printing, with an explicit module allowlist.
Use PROJ with bundled local resources and networking disabled for georeferencing.
Represent lines, arcs, holes, winding, tangency, and topology as analytical geometry rather than screen strokes.
Construct and edit true curves using chord length, arc length, arc height, and angle inputs.
Support rise-and-run entry, relative turns, explicit angles, and unit-aware direction input.
Provide alignment, snapping, point jumping, automatic closure, and bay-window completion while retaining exact geometry.
Support editable parallel, perpendicular, horizontal, vertical, coincident, and fixed-length relationships.
Preview dimension changes with an explicit anchored endpoint and an explicit choice about moving connected geometry.
Detect redundant, contradictory, underconstrained, and near-singular constraint states with understandable diagnostics; never silently relax locked measurements.
Prevent unintended mirrored solutions, winding changes, topology changes, and unstable alternate branches during solve.
Failed geometric edits preserve the previous valid document state and produce a reversible error result.
Model levels and floor-to-floor relationships through an explicit vertical dependency graph.
Provide a modern Draw First workflow with the documented Apex behavior and equivalent efficient completion path.
Provide a modern Define First workflow with the documented Apex behavior and equivalent efficient completion path.
Build areas from existing geometry and preserve unfinished sketches for later completion.
Support keyboard distance-and-direction entry with predictable focus, commit, cancel, and repeat behavior.
Accept fractional inches, feet-and-inches, metric units, and unit-aware precision input without lossy intermediate rounding.
Preserve efficient keyboard semantics and provide an Apex-compatible shortcut preset alongside customizable shortcuts.
Support point jumping, automatic closure, and bay-window completion as explicit geometry operations.
Expose curved wall and boundary construction through actual curve geometry, including chord, arc length, arc height, and angle definitions.
Support selection and clipboard operations for geometry, areas, annotations, and architectural objects.
Support rotation and flipping of supported geometry, areas, references, annotations, and architectural objects with explicit pivot behavior.
Support vertex insertion and cloning for applicable boundaries, walls, and objects without breaking constraints or area topology.
Support reopening, redefining, and deleting areas and supported objects while retaining explicit history and relationships.
Every committed operation, including classification, calibration, and compound edits, supports complete undo and redo.
Detect, aggregate, and subtract areas from analytical boundaries with explicit grouping and hole behavior.
Support classifications, base area, factors, net area, and explicit measurement profiles.
Report perimeter, living-area totals, building totals, and other required area aggregates with configurable rounding.
Make every total inspectable through boundary, deduction, classification, factor, rounding, and provenance details, including documented Auto-Subtract behavior.
Provide editable text and label libraries with per-instance content, style, placement, and visibility.
Provide editable dimensions with placement, visibility, styles, references, and independent output-scale behavior.
Support editable drawing styles, fills, and visibility controls for areas, objects, and output views.

Provide a comprehensive, editable, size-adjustable symbol library for residential and light-commercial drawings, with at least 300 distinct usable families spanning plumbing, furniture, fixtures, appliances, accessibility, lighting, doors/windows, structural/site, and commercial equipment.
Import PDF and raster reference images as project assets for tracing and calibrated presentation.
Calibrate a reference image against a known measurement and preserve calibration provenance.
Trace over references and support resize, rotate, flip, intensity adjustment, and show/hide controls without changing source assets.
Support multipage projects with subject information, area attributes, page-level presentation, and shared project data.
Support local save, import, export, and declared legacy-version exchange workflows with fidelity reports.
Provide page layouts, print preview, PDF output, and image output with independent output scale.
Provide pan, zoom, grid, independent output scale, and responsive overview navigation without rebuilding the whole interface.
Provide visibility filters, overview map, light/dark themes, and saved workspace configurations.
Provide a searchable command palette, shortcut editing, and view tabs without duplicating primary commands in a second toolbar menu.
Support mouse, keyboard, active pen, and touch input for precision drawing and editing.
Support DISTO measurement input through an adapter that targets an explicitly selected field and retains units and provenance.
Provide survey and metes-and-bounds workflows with traverse geometry, acreage calculation, closure diagnostics, and output.
Provide the Pro georeferencing workflow with explicit coordinate reference, control points, residuals, and offline resources.
Provide appraisal-software integrations through isolated, versioned adapters with explicit field mapping and failure behavior.
Document and implement caller protocols for external integrations without coupling them to the drawing engine.
Import and preserve supported native Apex v5 projects with geometry, curves, classifications, dimensions, labels, symbols, imagery, and metadata where representable.
Import, edit, and preserve supported native Apex v7 projects with geometry, curves, classifications, dimensions, labels, symbols, imagery, and metadata where representable.
Export declared legacy Apex-compatible versions with explicit subset, loss, and round-trip behavior.
Audit Apex Standard, Pro, and enabled modules rather than infer feature scope from purchase price or public documentation alone.
Compare representative Apex projects and expected outputs across geometry, curves, classifications, dimensions, labels, symbols, imagery, metadata, calculations, and print/export.
Author straight, curved, sloped, and composite walls with joins, thickness, materials, and stable semantic identity.
Author hosted doors, windows, and openings with type/instance properties and wall relationships.
Author floors, ceilings, foundations, and their materials, levels, boundaries, and quantities.
Author beams and columns suitable for residential and light-commercial building documentation.
Author flat, shed, gable, and hip roof forms with slopes, joins, openings where supported, and materials.
Author stairs, landings, and railings with level connections and editable dimensions.
Provide levels, reference grids, floor-to-floor alignment, and basic site/terrain tools.
Provide reusable assemblies with separate type and instance properties, materials, and quantity behavior.
Model rooms and architectural boundaries separately from appraisal measurement boundaries, with explicit relationships where desired.
Support existing, demolished, and proposed phases across the model, views, calculations, schedules, and sheets.
Support mutually exclusive remodeling alternatives over a shared existing model with clear comparison state.
Provide editable 3D authoring over the same semantic objects used by measurement and 2D documentation.
Provide coordinated plans, elevations, and sections that edit and display the same building objects.
Sections support cut depth, line treatment, material hatching, annotations, and detail overlays.
Provide door/window, room, and material schedules with the required marks, properties, dimensions, counts, areas, deductions, and net quantities.
Editable schedule cells issue normal document commands; calculated cells are read-only and expose their source.
Provide coordinated sheets with title blocks, revisions, callouts, schedules, and independently scaled viewports.
Every supported architectural object supports creation, selection, property editing, appropriate transforms, duplication, deletion, undo/redo, and save/reopen.
Plans, elevations, sections, 3D, calculations, schedules, and sheets use explicit stable references to the same semantic objects.
Support complete residential and light-commercial remodel documentation from existing conditions through alternatives and coordinated output.
Use a canvas-centered workspace with compact tool rail, expandable navigator, contextual inspector, and cursor-adjacent measurement panel.
Selecting a wall, area, reference, or architectural object exposes its relevant dimensions, relationships, styling, calibration, classifications, or calculations without unrelated modal dialogs.
Provide split plan/3D views, view tabs, saved workspaces, light/dark themes, and a high-contrast field mode.
Support keyboard navigation, predictable focus, accessible properties and commands, high contrast, and layouts from 1366x768 through 4K at 100%, 150%, and 200% scaling.
Provide pen/touch-specific controls and an on-screen measurement keypad while preserving keyboard precision paths.
Provide optional offline suggested tracing from plans or reference images.
Provide optional offline dimension extraction from supported plans and references.
Provide optional assisted label placement and natural-language commands through the same command and permission model as manual edits.
Assistance never silently invents measurements, changes classifications, or modifies accepted geometry; disabling it does not affect deterministic workflows.
Distributed assistance assets and processing libraries have offline resource paths, provenance, and license records.
Provide local autosave, recoverable history, and crash/power-loss recovery with explicit edited, autosaved, and saved states.
Provide named revisions and comparison views for semantic, geometric, calculation, and presentation changes.
Provide portable project packages and reusable templates containing required assets, profiles, and documentation references.
Detect external changes and enforce exclusive editing ownership, with read-only or independent-copy behavior for a second opening.
Failure-injection tests cover transaction, serialization, flush, replacement, recovery, migration, disk exhaustion, file locks, damaged assets, stale recovery, and newer schemas.
Support the declared IFC4 ADD2 TC1 Reference View 1.2 interchange target with editable reconstruction where reliable and identifiable reference preservation otherwise.
Support a declared DXF R2013 subset covering lines, arcs, polylines, text, dimensions, hatches, and blocks.
Treat PDF and raster underlays as calibrated reference assets, and distinguish editable extraction from simple tracing or image display.
Preview, PDF, SVG, and printing consume one vector scene; raster imagery and shaded 3D are explicitly identified raster content.
Support Letter, Legal, Tabloid, A4, A3, and architectural sheet sizes with independent scale and printer calibration verification.
Block authoritative output or clearly mark drafts when calculations, required references, assets, or fingerprints are stale or incomplete.
Run untrusted import workers in Windows AppContainer without network capabilities, with Job Object limits, brokered inputs, controlled temporary storage, and fixed search paths.
Contain malformed imports, path traversal, decompression bombs, DLL/module planting, child-process escape, timeouts, and worker crashes.
Disable PROJ networking and custom network callbacks; missing coordinate resources produce a local diagnostic instead of an attempted download.
Target 95th-percentile navigation frame time at or below 16.7 ms on agreed reference hardware for representative workloads.
Target input feedback at or below 50 ms and ordinary edits at or below 250 ms, with expensive regeneration in cancellable background work.
Target representative project open/save at or below five seconds while preserving snapshot and asset integrity.
Validate geometry, calculations, constraints, units, factors, rounding, topology, and persistence through independent analytical fixtures.

Pass an integrated residential production fixture exercising measurement, architectural authoring, editable 3D, plans, elevations, sections, schedules, alternatives, revisions, sheets, save/reopen, print, and export.
Pass an integrated light-commercial production fixture exercising multiple levels, assemblies, structural objects, schedules, quantities, sheets, and coordinated views.
Complete Create, measure, model in 3D, use optional assistance, edit, calculate, revise, save, reopen, recover, print, and export on a clean offline Windows machine.
Verify real pen/touch input, keyboard navigation, focus behavior, accessible properties, themes, high contrast, and supported DPI layouts.
Deliver signed or otherwise integrity-verifiable offline installer and portable Windows packages with no hidden network prerequisite.
Deliver offline help, keyboard/workflow reference, source/build kit, dependency sources/notices/SBOM, format and adapter documentation, fixtures, and verification reports.
